steps: Press the test button on each detector and listen for the alarm tone.
Open the battery compartment and swap in a fresh battery (9V or AA depending on model).
Reinstall and press test again to confirm it's working.
Vacuum dust from the vents on the detector housing.
Replace the entire unit if it's over 10 years old, regardless of battery.
